judge.rationale: The answers share a clear core involving FXYD6-regulated Na+/K+-ATPase activity and KCNQ5/KCNMB4-related potassium conductance, with some recurrence of Kcna3 and Kcnd3, but more than half of the complete molecular content differs through A’s morphology module, C’s tonic GABA/ANO4 and lineage program, D’s GABRD-centered subtype and gating-modulator explanation, and B’s PVALB emphasis, so the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
